abilities.desc: Hurl three fireballs (5 damage each) that burst and set targets alight. Every Infernal hit builds Heat, the meter under your abilities. At 100 Heat your next ability is Overheated: +40% damage in a white-hot flash.
abilities.variants: Level: a fan of three fireballs (five with Extra Fuel; the last is a meteor with Meteor). Up: Mortar, shells arc high and crash down in fiery bursts. Down: Pinwheel, embers spin out around you in a ring and seek out nearby foes.

abilities.desc: Raise a wall of fire that burns enemies standing in it and incinerates projectiles that pass through.
abilities.variants: Level: a wall across your path (a ring around you with Ring of Fire). Up: Marching Tide, a wave of flame rolls forward and shoves enemies back. Down: Burning Lane, a long strip of fire stretches ahead of you.

abilities.desc: Mark the ground. A second later it erupts in a geyser of magma that hurls enemies into the air and sets them on fire.
abilities.variants: Level: the geyser where you aim. Moving: a fissure races ahead of you and erupts in a chain. Up: Molten Bombs, globs of magma fall on enemies around you. Down: Volcanic Leap, the ground erupts beneath you and throws you skyward.

abilities.desc: Become a living blaze for 10 s, with a burning aura and fireballs that seek your foes.
abilities.variants: Level: the Avatar form. Up: Ascendant, rise and hover while fire rains down twice as fast. Down: Supernova, a 1.5 s charge that detonates in a huge 14-damage blast around you.

p2d: Your melee hits sear: they set enemies on fire and build Heat.
awd: Your flames turn into blue soul fire and deal 1 extra damage per second to burning enemies.
